name: Tomorrow Technologies Global Innovations Limited
about: Tomorrow Technologies Global Innovations Limited operates as an artificial intelligence (AI) company. It operates through Content Sale, AI & DEV OPS, and Other Business Income segments. The company provides research content to investors through research reports. Its products include Chakry Comments, Reliable Insights, Breaking News, Special Feature, Street Call, Commodity Guidelines, and Derivative Strategy. The company also offers research-based statements on the behavior of Indian economy and Indian capital markets. In addition, it is involved in the purchase and sale of equity shares. Further, the company engages in development and deployment of AI-driven solutions; machine learning model training and consulting; AI-powered data analytics and automation; research and development in responsible and ethical AI applications; and AI education, training, and capacity-building services. It serves retail and small investors. The company was formerly known as Cni Research Limited and changed its name to Tomorrow Technologies Global Innovations Limited in January 2024. Tomorrow Technologies Global Innovations Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
